# STUR Physics Lab — AI/LLM information

> STUR-ROLL: Lambda-CDM plus one derived sector that predicts the CMB
> birefringence angle from integers, |beta| = k alpha / 2 with k = 1,
> i.e. 0.2091 deg, with no continuous parameter fitted.

## Scope
- Not a theory of everything and not a replacement for Lambda-CDM or GR.
- Gravity is TEGR (= GR): passes GR precision tests by construction.
- The new sector carries <~2e-5 of the matter energy; all other
  cosmological observables are those of Lambda-CDM. It explains neither
  dark matter nor dark energy.
- The observable is prior art (Lee, Murai, Takahashi & Yin, PRD 112,
  043538, 2025); STUR-ROLL derives their two assumptions from a 5D theory.

## Key predictions (LiteBIRD)
- |beta| = alpha/2 = 0.209 deg.
- Tomography: beta_reio - beta_rec in [-0.209, -0.122] deg (round 7).
- |beta(low l) - beta(high l)| <= alpha/2 (calibration-free).
- No anisotropic birefringence at recombination.

- /index.html — interactive site: simulator, tomography, plain/technical modes

- /docs/IMPLICATIONS.md — what confirmation would mean for physics
- /docs/GLOSSARY.md — terms in plain and precise language
- /docs/STATUS.md — derived, corrected, assumed, open
- /docs/REFINEMENT_R7.md — full math audit
- /docs/REFINEMENT_R8.md — dark matter and dark energy modules: both no-go (preregistered)
- /docs/REFINEMENT_R9.md — Cabibbo angle: not predicted (preregistered)
- /docs/ARCHIVE_TRIAGE.md — archive claims screened: none survives
- /src/stur_final.py — reproducible computation (numpy, scipy; ~30 s)
- /src/checks/ — one script per refinement round
